sources.why: SNB buys foreign currency by crediting banks' sight deposits:
GLD creations and redemptions are Western investment demand for physical gold; tonnes change against price separates investor flow from central-bank and Asian physical buying.
NSE splits every derivatives contract by owner:
Japanese lifers, pensions and toshin buying foreign bonds sell yen; foreign buying of Japanese stocks buys it.
